newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths says retail rent cost up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths says retail rent cost up.

text.p: Grocery retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Monday rental expenses for retailers in some major shopping centres had risen significantly and a number of individual retailers were suffering as a result.
"We've seen rent escalations in there that probably are in excess of what we would determine are correct," Woolworths managing director, Reg Clairs told a news conference.
However, Clairs said Woolworths generally had long term leases and the company was managing its leasehold and rent costs appropriately.

"In many of the large shopping centres, the small tenants are paying a mandatory increase per annum of five or six percent irrespective of whatever their sales are and that is an issue for the community at large," said the head of Woolworths general merchandise division, Roger Corbett.
"Certainly for our smaller businesses, in the main Rockmans and Dick Smith, this is an issue," he said.
